explains.en: It can name a small animal that flies at night. It can also name a long tool used to hit a ball. As a verb, it means striking something with that tool.
This word may describe a flying animal that sleeps in dark places. It may also mean a wooden or metal sports tool. A player can use it to hit a ball.
One meaning is a night animal with wings. Another meaning is a tool used in some ball games. The verb describes hitting with that tool.

examples.en: The baseball player swung the bat and hit the ball.
examples.zh: 那位棒球選手揮棒擊中了球。

examples.en: A bat flew out of the dark cave.
examples.zh: 一隻蝙蝠飛出黑暗的洞穴。

examples.en: She will bat first for our team.
examples.zh: 她會擔任我們隊的第一位打擊手。

explains.en: This is a piece of furniture used for sleeping. It usually has a soft place for a person to lie down. Sheets and blankets cover it.
People rest on this furniture at night. It may have a frame, a mattress, and pillows. A room can hold one or more.
This word names the place where someone sleeps. It is often covered with sheets and a blanket. People lie on it when they are tired.

examples.en: I go to bed at ten o'clock every night.
examples.zh: 我每晚十點上床睡覺。

examples.en: Make sure you make your bed before leaving the room.
examples.zh: 離開房間前請務必整理好床鋪。

examples.en: The hotel bed was very soft and comfortable.
examples.zh: 飯店的床非常柔軟舒適。

explains.en: It describes something with a large size. A tree may be much taller than a child. The word can also mean important.
Use this word for something that takes up much space. It can describe a large number or a strong change. It may also tell that an event matters a lot.
This word means large in size or amount. It can describe a house, crowd, or sound. It can also mean important to many people.

examples.en: Taipei 101 is a very big skyscraper.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是一棟非常巨大的摩天大樓。

examples.en: Passing the entrance examination was a big milestone in her life.
examples.zh: 通過入學考試是她人生中的一個重大里程碑。

examples.en: The smiling child greeted his grandparents with a big hug.
examples.zh: 面帶微笑的孩子給了祖父母一個大大的擁抱。

explains.en: This is a small insect. It can also mean a mistake in a computer program. A hidden listening device may have this name too.
A tiny creature may crawl on the ground. In computer work, the same word names an error that makes a program behave wrongly. It can also name a small device that listens secretly.
This word can mean a small crawling creature. It may also describe a problem in computer code. In another use, it names a secret listening device.

examples.en: Programmers worked through the night to fix the critical software bug.
examples.zh: 程式設計師徹夜奮戰以修復關鍵的軟體程式錯誤。

examples.en: Users discovered an unexpected bug that caused the app to close abruptly.
examples.zh: 使用者發現了一個導致應用程式突然閃退的意外錯誤。

examples.en: A thorough testing phase helps detect nasty software bugs before release.
examples.zh: 全面的測試階段有助於在軟體發布前找出棘手的程式漏洞。

explains.en: This helper verb shows that an action is possible for someone. The same spelling names a metal container for food or drink. The related action means preserving food inside such a container.
Use this small verb to talk about skill or permission. The same word names a metal vessel. People may preserve food inside one.
This word may tell that an action is possible. It may also name a container with a lid. A factory seals food inside one.

examples.en: You can borrow up to ten books from the library.
examples.zh: 你可以在圖書館借多達十本書。

examples.en: Open a can of tuna to make delicious sandwiches for lunch.
examples.zh: 開一罐鮪魚罐頭做美味的三明治當午餐。

examples.en: With sufficient determination and practice, anyone can learn a foreign language.
examples.zh: 只要有足夠的決心與練習，任何人都能學會一門外語。

explains.en: This is a soft hat with a rounded top. It may have a flat part that shades the eyes. A container’s cover may also have this name.
People wear this head covering in sunny weather. It can have a short front edge. The word can also mean putting a limit on something.
This word names a simple hat or lid. It can shade someone’s face. As a verb, it can mean setting a highest amount.

examples.en: Many baseball fans wear team caps.
examples.zh: 許多棒球迷都會戴球隊的棒球帽。

examples.en: Twist the bottle cap tightly to avoid leaking water.
examples.zh: 旋緊瓶蓋以防漏水。

examples.en: He pulled his black baseball cap down low over his forehead.
examples.zh: 他把黑色的棒球帽壓低到額頭前。

explains.en: This is a small furry animal often kept in a home. It has sharp claws and whiskers. It may make a soft purring sound.
The animal has pointed ears and a long tail. It may chase mice or play with string. Many people keep one as a pet.
This word names a common pet with fur. It can climb and land on its feet. It may sleep for many hours each day.

examples.en: The black cat is resting on the windowsill.
examples.zh: 那隻黑貓正趴在窗台上休息。

examples.en: My cat purrs softly whenever I gently stroke its fur.
examples.zh: 每當我輕撫我家的貓咪時，牠便發出輕柔的呼嚕聲。

examples.en: Stray cats in the neighborhood are fed by kind residents.
examples.zh: 社區裡的流浪貓受到好心居民的餵食照顧。

explains.en: It means separating something with a sharp tool. It can also name a small wound in the skin. A cook may do this to vegetables.
Use this word when scissors or a knife divide something. It may also mean a mark made by a sharp edge. A person should handle sharp tools safely.
This word can mean dividing material into pieces. It can name a small opening in skin. It can also mean reducing the amount of something.

examples.en: Cut the apple into four equal slices.
examples.zh: 把蘋果切成四等份切片。

examples.en: He went to the barbershop on Saturday to get a neat hair cut.
examples.zh: 他週六去理髮店剪了一個俐落的髮型。

examples.en: The government announced plans to cut public transportation fares for seniors.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了調降長者大眾運輸票價的計劃。

explains.en: It means making a hole in the ground with a tool or hands. A gardener may do this to plant seeds. It can also name the hole made.
Use this word when moving soil to make a hole. A dog may use its paws to uncover a toy. The action can leave a pile of dirt nearby.
This verb means moving earth away from one place. People may do it with a shovel. The noun can name a place where soil has been removed.

examples.en: The dog dug a hole in the garden.
examples.zh: 狗在花園裡挖了一個洞。

examples.en: They dug for shells on the beach.
examples.zh: 他們在海灘上挖貝殼。

examples.en: We will dig a small pond for the frogs.
examples.zh: 我們要為青蛙挖一個小池塘。

explains.en: It can name a machine with turning blades that moves air. It can also mean someone who likes a team or performer. As a verb, it can mean moving air with a hand-held object.
People use this device to feel a breeze in warm weather. A sports lover may follow a team closely. The verb means making air move toward someone.
This word can mean a person who strongly likes a singer or team. It may name a device with blades. The action means moving air with a hand.

examples.en: Turn on the fan to cool the room.
examples.zh: 打開電風扇讓房間涼爽一點。

examples.en: Thousands of screaming sports fans filled the baseball stadium.
examples.zh: 數萬名熱情尖叫的球迷擠滿了棒球場。

examples.en: An oscillating electric fan keeps the bedroom comfortable on warm nights.
examples.zh: 擺頭電風扇讓溫熱的夜晚臥室保持涼爽舒適。

explains.en: This is enjoyment or a happy activity. People may have it while playing a game. The word can describe something that makes people laugh or smile.
Use this word for a good time with friends. A party may bring laughter. A trip may be enjoyable even when it is tiring.
This word names pleasure and enjoyment. It may describe a game or joke. People often seek it in their free time.

examples.en: Learning English through pop songs is real fun.
examples.zh: 透過流行歌曲學習英語真的很有趣。

examples.en: Have fun at the water amusement park with your classmates!
examples.zh: 和你的同班同學在水上樂園玩得盡興開心喔！

examples.en: Don't make fun of others when they make innocent pronunciation slips.
examples.zh: 當別人無心念錯發音時，不要取笑他們。

explains.en: It means receiving or obtaining something. It can also mean becoming a certain way or reaching a place. The exact sense depends on nearby words.
Use this verb when someone receives a gift. It may also describe a person changing into a new state. A traveler may reach a town.
This common verb can mean obtaining an item. It may describe becoming tired or happy. It can also mean arriving at a destination.

examples.en: What time do you get up in the morning?
examples.zh: 你早上通常幾點起床？

examples.en: Get ready quickly, or we will be late for the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 快點準備好，否則我們要趕不上開幕典禮了。

examples.en: She was excited to get a high score on her English listening test.
examples.zh: 她在英文聽力測驗中拿到高分，感到非常興奮。

explains.en: This is a piece of clothing worn on the head. It usually has a shaped edge all around. People may wear one to keep the sun off.
Someone may wear this item outside. It can be made of straw, cloth, or felt. A brim helps shade the face.
This word names a head covering with an edge. It may protect someone from sun or rain. People wear it for style too.

examples.en: He wore a straw hat to protect from the sun.
examples.zh: 他戴了一頂草帽來防曬。

examples.en: Take off your hat when you enter the church.
examples.zh: 進入教堂時請脫下帽子。

examples.en: The colorful knit hat kept her ears warm during the hike.
examples.zh: 健行時，這頂色彩繽紛的針織帽保護她的雙耳免受風寒。

explains.en: This is an adult female chicken. It lays eggs in a nest. Farmers may keep several in a yard.
The bird has feathers and a beak. It may cluck while looking for food. Its eggs are gathered for people to eat.
This word names a female farm bird. It may care for chicks. People often raise it for eggs.

examples.en: The hen laid three eggs this morning.
examples.zh: 母雞今天早上生了三顆蛋。

examples.en: A brown hen walked across the yard.
examples.zh: 一隻棕色母雞走過院子。

examples.en: The hen kept her chicks warm.
examples.zh: 母雞讓小雞保持溫暖。

explains.en: It means striking someone or something. A ball may touch a wall and move away. It can also name a successful blow or result.
Use this word for making contact with force. A hand may strike a drum. The noun can name the forceful touch itself.
This verb means touching or striking a target. A player may send a ball toward another person. It can also describe reaching someone by phone.

examples.en: The ball hit the window and broke it.
examples.zh: 球打中窗戶，把它打破了。

examples.en: She hit the drum with a stick.
examples.zh: 她用鼓棒敲鼓。

examples.en: The team got a hit in the final inning.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在最後一局擊出安打。

explains.en: It describes a high temperature. A soup may feel this way just after cooking. It can also describe spicy food or something popular.
Use this word for something that has much warmth. A summer day may feel this way. It may also mean fashionable or in demand.
This word tells that something has a high temperature. Pepper may give food this quality. A new song may be very popular.

examples.en: Summer in southern Taiwan is very hot.
examples.zh: 台灣南部的夏天非常炎熱。

examples.en: Enjoying a hot spring bath is relaxing in cold winter weather.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬日裡享受溫泉泡湯非常放鬆。

examples.en: Be careful not to burn your tongue on the hot soup.
examples.zh: 小心別被滾燙的熱湯燙到舌頭。

explains.en: This is an adult male person. The word can also mean humans in general in some old writing. A person may work as a helper or worker.
Use this word for an adult male. In older language, it can refer to all people. The sentence shows how it is being used.
This word names an adult male person. It may appear in job names. In some older texts, it means humankind.

examples.en: The tall man is our principal.
examples.zh: 那位高個子的男人是我們的校長。

examples.en: A young man helped the old lady cross the street.
examples.zh: 一位年輕男子幫忙老太太過馬路。

examples.en: That man works as an engineer at a tech company.
examples.zh: 那位男士在一間科技公司擔任工程師。

explains.en: This is a drawing that shows roads, places, or land. Travelers use it to find a way. As a verb, it means showing where things are.
A paper or screen may show where cities and rivers lie. A person can use it to plan a trip. The verb means marking places on a drawing.
This word names a guide to places. It can show streets or the whole world. The action means making such a guide.

examples.en: Use Google Maps to find the best route.
examples.zh: 使用 Google 地圖來尋找最佳路線。

examples.en: The MRT network map clearly displays all transfer stations.
examples.zh: 捷運路線圖清楚標示了所有的轉乘站點。

examples.en: Explorers carefully mapped the uncharted coastal islands in the seventeenth century.
examples.zh: 探險家在十七世紀仔細繪製了未探明海岸島嶼的地圖。

explains.en: This is a mesh used to catch fish or hold a ball. It has many small openings. As a verb, it means catching an animal with such a tool.
People throw this woven tool into water to catch fish. A sports goal may have one behind it. The verb describes catching with it.
This word names a mesh made from string or rope. It can stop a ball or catch food. As an action, it means catching with a mesh tool.

examples.en: The fisherman threw his net into the water.
examples.zh: 漁夫把網撒進水裡。

examples.en: The soccer ball hit the net.
examples.zh: 足球打中了球網。

examples.en: They netted several fish before sunset.
examples.zh: 日落前他們捕到了幾條魚。

explains.en: A person uses this tool to write with ink. It may have a cap to keep the tip clean. Some people use it to sign a letter.
This writing tool has a small point. Dark liquid comes from it onto a page. Students may carry one in a bag.
A person holds this tool and moves it across paper. It leaves a colored line. A cap may cover its small writing tip.

examples.en: Can I borrow your blue pen?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的藍色原子筆嗎？

examples.en: The black pen has run out of ink.
examples.zh: 那支黑色原子筆已經沒水了。

examples.en: Sign your signature here with this black ink pen.
examples.zh: 用這支黑墨水筆在這裡簽上你的名字。

explains.en: A family may keep this animal at home. A dog or cat can have this role. The word can also mean gently touching an animal.
This is an animal cared for in a home. A child may feed it and play with it. As an action, the word means stroking an animal gently.
A bird, fish, or cat may live with a family. The animal depends on people for care. A person may softly stroke its fur.

examples.en: Keeping a pet requires love, time, and responsibility.
examples.zh: 飼養寵物需要愛心、時間和責任感。

examples.en: The kind girl gently pet the sleeping golden retriever.
examples.zh: 善良的女孩溫柔地撫摸著熟睡的黃金獵犬。

examples.en: Do you have any pets at home, like a dog or bird?
examples.zh: 你家裡有養任何寵物嗎，像是狗或鳥？

explains.en: This farm animal has a round body and a short nose. It may live in a pen. It often makes a snorting sound.
A farmer may raise this animal for food. It has four legs and a curly tail. Young ones are called piglets.
This animal is often pink or brown. It looks for food with its nose. A mother may care for many small babies.

examples.en: Pigs are actually very smart animals.
examples.zh: 豬其實是非常聰明的動物。

examples.en: The farmer feeds the mother pig fresh vegetables and corn.
examples.zh: 農夫用新鮮蔬菜和玉米餵養母豬。

examples.en: He has been collecting coins in his ceramic piggy bank for a year.
examples.zh: 他把硬幣存在他的陶瓷小豬撲滿裡已經一年了。

entries.definition: （名）別針；圖釘；識別碼；標記點；（動）別住；固定。

explains.en: This small metal item can hold cloth together. It has a sharp point and a round head. People may also use it to attach a note to a board.
A map may use this small object to mark a place. It can fasten two pieces of fabric. The pointed end must be handled with care.
This little tool has a narrow metal body. It may go through paper to hold it on a wall. A person may put one in a shirt to close a tear.

examples.en: She used a pin to hold the note on the board.
examples.zh: 她用圖釘把紙條固定在板子上。

examples.en: A safety pin kept his coat closed.
examples.zh: 一枚別針讓他的外套保持扣好。

examples.en: The map has a pin at our hotel.
examples.zh: 地圖上在我們的旅館位置有一個標記。

explains.en: A cook uses this deep container to heat soup. It often has a handle on each side. A flower may grow in one made from clay.
This container can hold water or food. It may sit on a stove. A gardener can use a small one for a flower.
A kitchen has this item for cooking. It is deeper than a plate. A clay one can hold soil and a plant.

examples.en: Put the beef chunks into the hot pot to simmer.
examples.zh: 把牛肉塊放入熱湯鍋中慢火燉煮。

examples.en: She planted colorful petunias in a large ceramic flower pot.
examples.zh: 她在大陶花盆裡栽種了色彩繽紛的矮牽牛。

examples.en: Keep the heavy lid firmly on the pot while cooking rice.
examples.zh: 煮飯時請將厚重的鍋蓋緊緊蓋在鍋子上。

explains.en: This color is like the skin of a ripe tomato. It may be dark or light. It is one of the main colors in a rainbow.
A stop sign has this bright color. Strawberries may have the same shade. A person may wear a shirt of this color.
This is the color of many apples. It is made by mixing light from certain parts of the rainbow. A warm face may show this shade.

examples.en: The traffic light turned red, so we stopped.
examples.zh: 紅綠燈變紅燈了，所以我們停了下來。

examples.en: She wore a bright red coat that stood out in the snow.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件亮紅色的外套，在雪地中格外顯眼。

examples.en: Red apples taste sweet and crisp in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天的紅蘋果吃起來又甜又脆。

explains.en: A person moves quickly using their legs. Water can also flow through a pipe. A business may be managed by someone.
Children may do this around a field. A machine can work for many hours. The word may also mean leading a shop or company.
This action is faster than walking. A stream can flow over stones. A person may manage a small business.

examples.en: He runs three kilometers every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上跑三公里。

examples.en: Don't run in the school hallway, or you might trip and fall.
examples.zh: 不要在學校走廊奔跑，否則可能會絆倒受傷。

examples.en: His uncle has run a successful family restaurant for twenty years.
examples.zh: 他的叔叔經營一間成功的家族餐廳已有二十年。

explains.en: It means resting on a chair with the body upright. A person may do this at a desk. A dog can do it when told.
A child can be on a chair during a lesson. The body is lower than when standing. A cat may stay in this position by a window.
This position uses a chair or bench. A person may stay still during a meal. A teacher may ask a class to do this.

examples.en: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
examples.zh: 請坐下，請放輕鬆。

examples.en: We sat by the window watching the raindrops fall into the garden.
examples.zh: 我們坐在窗邊看著雨滴落在花園裡。

examples.en: Sit up straight during class to prevent back pain and fatigue.
examples.zh: 上課時坐姿端正可以預防背部痠痛與疲勞。

explains.en: A bright star gives light and warmth to Earth. It rises in the morning and sets at night. Plants need its light to grow.
People feel its warmth on a clear day. The moon reflects its light. It is the star closest to Earth.
This star lights the day. It helps plants make food. A person should not look at it directly.

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
examples.zh: 太陽從東方升起。

examples.en: Wearing sunglasses protects your eyes from the bright sun.
examples.zh: 戴太陽眼鏡可以保護眼睛免受強烈陽光傷害。

examples.en: The flowers blossomed happily under the morning sun.
examples.zh: 花兒在晨光朝陽下燦爛綻放。

explains.en: It means the highest part of something. A hat may sit there. A mountain can reach high above the land.
A cup may be filled up to its edge. A person can stand at the highest point of a hill. The word can also mean a lid.
This word can name the upper part of a box. A cap may cover it. A person who is best may be at the highest level.

examples.en: We reached the top of the mountain at noon.
examples.zh: 我們在中午抵達了山頂。

examples.en: She ranked at the very top of her graduating high school class.
examples.zh: 她在高中畢業班中名列前茅、榮登榜首。

examples.en: Put the heavy storage boxes at the bottom and lighter ones on top.
examples.zh: 把沉重的收納箱放在底部，較輕的放在頂層。

explains.en: It means covered in water or another liquid. Rain can make clothes this way. A sponge can become soaked.
A person may step in a puddle and get shoes soaked. A towel can dry a surface. The word can describe something not dry.
A dog may come inside after swimming with its fur soaked. Rain can leave a road shiny. This describing word means damp.

examples.en: The grass was wet after the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨後草地是濕的。

examples.en: His wet shoes dried by the door.
examples.zh: 他的濕鞋子在門邊晾乾了。

examples.en: We got wet while swimming in the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖裡游泳時全身都濕了。

explains.en: A small round bread roll is often eaten for breakfast. It may have a sweet filling. A person can cut it in half.
A baker may make this soft bread. It can contain cinnamon or fruit. People may eat it with butter.
This little bread can be sweet. It is shaped like a small roll. A person may have it with tea.

examples.en: We ate a warm bun with soup.
examples.zh: 我們喝湯時吃了一個熱麵包。

examples.en: She bought a sweet bun at the bakery.
examples.zh: 她在麵包店買了一個甜麵包。

examples.en: The bun had raisins inside.
examples.zh: 這個麵包裡有葡萄乾。

entries.definition: （名）點；小圓點；（動）星羅棋布；點綴

explains.en: This is a very small round mark. A pen can make one by briefly touching paper. Several can form a pattern.
This mark appears in some written addresses. It separates parts of a website name. People say its name when reading that address aloud.
The verb describes placing small marks across a surface. A child may add spots to a drawing. The marks can be spread far apart.

examples.en: Put a dot at the end of the sentence.
examples.zh: 在句子末尾加一個句點。

examples.en: A black dot appeared on the paper.
examples.zh: 紙上出現一個黑點。

examples.en: The dress is covered with tiny blue dots.
examples.zh: 這件洋裝上布滿了小藍點。

entries.definition: 合身；合適；健康的；適合；健美的

explains.en: It means being healthy and strong. A shirt can also be the right size. A piece may go into a space.
A person who exercises may be in good health. Clothes should match the body. A lid can go onto a jar.
This word can mean healthy, suitable, or the right size. A person may exercise to stay strong. An item can go into another.

examples.en: This pair of blue jeans fits you perfectly.
examples.zh: 這條藍色牛仔褲你穿起來非常合身。

examples.en: Jogging every morning helps her stay healthy, lean, and fit.
examples.zh: 每天早晨慢跑幫助她保持健康、精實與體態良好。

examples.en: The large sofa cannot fit through the narrow front apartment door.
examples.zh: 這張大沙發沒辦法穿過公寓狹窄的大門。

examples.en: These blue jeans fit you perfectly!
examples.zh: 這條藍色牛仔褲穿在你身上非常合身！

examples.en: Exercising thirty minutes every morning keeps her healthy and fit.
examples.zh: 每天早晨運動三十分鐘讓她保持健康與健美體態。

examples.en: The new wooden bookcase won't fit through the narrow front doorway.
examples.zh: 這個新木製書櫃太大了，進不了狹窄的前門。

entries.definition: （動）單腳跳；跳躍；（名）短途飛行；跳躍。

explains.en: It means jumping on one foot. A child may do this over a line. A rabbit can jump.
A person may jump briefly. A bird can move from branch to branch. The word can also mean a small jump.
This action makes a short jump. A child may do it while playing. A rabbit can leap quickly.

examples.en: The rabbit hopped over the log.
examples.zh: 兔子跳過木頭。

examples.en: The child hopped on one foot.
examples.zh: 孩子單腳跳。

examples.en: The frog hopped into the pond.
examples.zh: 青蛙跳進池塘。

explains.en: A soft piece is placed on the floor by a door. A person may wipe shoes on it. It can also mean a flat pad.
A bath room may have one to keep feet warm. A cat may sit on one. It can be made from cloth or rubber.
This item lies on a floor. It can help keep dirt outside. A person may stand on it.

examples.en: Wipe your shoes on the mat.
examples.zh: 在墊子上擦擦鞋。

examples.en: The cat slept on a soft mat.
examples.zh: 貓睡在柔軟的墊子上。

examples.en: She put a mat under the plant pot.
examples.zh: 她在盆栽底下放了一個墊子。

explains.en: This noun is a cleaning tool with a long handle and soft strands at one end. People push it across a wet floor to collect water or spread soapy water. The same word can be used as a verb for cleaning in this way.
After dinner, someone may spill juice on the kitchen floor. A worker can use this tool with a bucket to clean the wet area. It is useful on smooth floors.
A broom has stiff bristles and is mainly used on dry dirt. This tool has softer strands and is often used with water. The verb form describes the action of moving it across a floor.

examples.en: Dad used a mop to clean the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 爸爸用拖把清理廚房地板。

examples.en: Please mop the small spill before someone slips.
examples.zh: 請把那灘小小的灑出物拖乾，免得有人滑倒。

examples.en: The cleaner rinsed the mop in a bucket.
examples.zh: 清潔人員在水桶裡沖洗拖把。

entries.definition: 馬克杯；大杯子；（口語）臉；搶劫

explains.en: This word can name a large cup with a handle, often used for coffee or tea. It can also mean a person’s face in informal speech, though that use can sound rude. In another informal use, it names a kind of robbery.
A traveler may buy a cup decorated with a picture of a city. At breakfast, someone might pour hot cocoa into it. The handle makes it easy to hold.

A large handled cup is usually bigger and heavier than a small teacup. The face-related use is casual and should be avoided when speaking politely. The word has several meanings, so the sentence helps show which one is intended.

examples.en: Grandpa drinks tea from his favorite mug.
examples.zh: 爺爺用他最喜歡的大杯子喝茶。

examples.en: The shop sells a mug with a picture of the moon.
examples.zh: 那家店賣印有月亮圖案的大杯子。

examples.en: She filled the mug with warm milk.
examples.zh: 她把大杯子裝滿溫牛奶。

entries.definition: 手工精密銼削導槽之天然牛骨上弦枕；堅果

explains.en: An almond grows inside a hard shell that protects the part people eat. A walnut has a shell that must be cracked open. The same word also names a metal fastener that screws onto a bolt.
A person may crack a shell to eat the food inside. A builder may turn a metal fastener onto a threaded rod to hold parts together. The surrounding words show the meaning.
Many edible kinds grow on trees, though peanuts grow underground and are technically legumes. The hardware kind is made of metal and has a hole with threads. The word has several everyday uses.

examples.en: Filing the top nut slots to the exact depth ensures comfortable open-string action without buzzing.
examples.zh: 將「天然牛骨上弦枕」（Nut）的弦槽精準銼至微米深度，確保空弦彈奏手感極致舒適且絕無雜音。

examples.en: The mechanic used a torque wrench to tighten the lug nut securely onto the wheel hub.
examples.zh: 汽車修護技師手持專業扭力板手，將輪圈固定六角螺帽以精確磅數牢牢鎖緊於輪轂軸承上。

examples.en: Squirrels spent the autumn gathering acorn nuts and burying them beneath oak leaf litter.
examples.zh: 森林裡活潑的小松鼠整個秋天忙得不可開交，到處收集肥美的橡實堅果並妥善埋藏在落葉堆下。

entries.definition: 平底鍋；烤盤；（動）鏡頭搖攝；嚴厲批評。

explains.en: This noun names a round, shallow metal container used for cooking. It may have a long handle and is placed over heat. The word can also mean a flat part of an instrument or device.
A cook may fry an egg in this container on a stove. A camper may carry a small one to prepare a meal outdoors. Its wide base spreads heat under food.
A pot is often deeper and can hold more liquid. This container is broad and shallow, so it is useful for frying. Context may also show that the word means a part shaped like a flat dish.

examples.en: Mom cooked the eggs in a pan.
examples.zh: 媽媽用平底鍋煎蛋。

examples.en: The hot pan sat on the stove.
examples.zh: 熱鍋放在爐子上。

examples.en: He placed the vegetables in a large pan.
examples.zh: 他把蔬菜放進一個大平底鍋裡。

entries.definition: （名）啪聲；流行音樂；汽水；（動）爆裂；彈出；（形）流行的

explains.en: This word can mean a short, sharp sound made when something bursts. It can also mean to burst open or make that sound. In music, it may describe popular styles with a strong beat.
A balloon may burst with a loud sound at a party. A child might open a toy bubble by pressing it. The word can copy the sound itself.
As a verb, it often describes a quick burst or sudden opening. As a noun, it can name the sound or a kind of music. Context shows which use fits.

examples.en: The balloon went pop when it touched the candle.
examples.zh: 氣球碰到蠟燭時啪一聲爆開了。

examples.en: The cork popped out of the bottle.
examples.zh: 瓶塞砰地從瓶子裡彈了出來。

examples.en: My dad likes listening to pop music.
examples.zh: 爸爸喜歡聽流行音樂。

explains.en: This number is one more than nine. It comes before eleven when counting.
A classroom may have this many children in a small group. A short wait can last this many minutes.
When counting, it comes after nine and before eleven. A perfect mark can be given for getting every question right on a quiz with this many points.

examples.en: Count from one to ten slowly.
examples.zh: 請從一慢慢數到十。

examples.en: It took only ten minutes to solve the math puzzle.
examples.zh: 解開這道數學謎題只花了十分鐘。

examples.en: She was among the top ten students in the grade.
examples.zh: 她名列年級前十名優秀學生之中。

explains.en: To put your arms around someone in a friendly way is to do this. It can show love, comfort, or welcome. Ask first if the other person is comfortable.
People also hold an object close to themselves. A child may hold a stuffed toy while resting. The verb can describe either kind of action.
A handshake uses hands only, while this gesture brings people close together. Some people prefer not to be touched. Respect their choice.

examples.en: Grandma gave me a hug when I arrived.
examples.zh: 我抵達時，奶奶抱了抱我。

examples.en: The child hugged his teddy bear at bedtime.
examples.zh: 孩子睡前抱著他的泰迪熊。

examples.en: She asked her friend before giving her a hug.
examples.zh: 她先詢問朋友，才抱了抱她。

explains.en: A small, simple shelter is called this. It may be built from wood, leaves, or other local materials. A person can stay inside to rest.
Some people use one as a cabin near a beach or in the mountains. It usually has fewer rooms than a house. Its design depends on the place.
A large home has many rooms, while this shelter is usually small. It can protect people from rain and sun. Strong materials help it stand safely.

examples.en: The guide rested in a small hut near the trail.
examples.zh: 嚮導在步道旁的小屋休息。

examples.en: A thatched hut stood beside the tropical beach.
examples.zh: 熱帶海灘旁有一間茅草小屋。

examples.en: The hikers found an empty hut before the rain began.
examples.zh: 雨開始下之前，健行者找到了一間空的小屋。

entries.definition: 成套工具；工具箱；配套組件；套件

explains.en: A set of tools or supplies packed together for a particular task is called this. A first-aid version contains items for small emergencies. Keep it where adults can find it.
People can buy a craft version with materials for making one project. The pieces and directions are usually included. It is fun to follow the steps.
A single tool is only one item, while this set includes several things used together. A repair box may have many pieces. Check that nothing important is missing.

examples.en: The art kit had paint, brushes, and thick paper.
examples.zh: 美術材料組裡有顏料、畫筆和厚紙。

examples.en: Dad packed a first-aid kit for the hike.
examples.zh: 爸爸為健行準備了一個急救包。

examples.en: The robot kit came with clear instructions.
examples.zh: 機器人套件附有清楚的說明。

entries.definition: 二十分鐘充電午睡；打盹 (Power Nap)

explains.en: A short sleep taken during the day is called this. A tired child may rest after lunch. The brief rest can help them feel refreshed.
As a verb, it means to sleep for a short time. A cat may do so in a sunny spot. The sleep usually does not last all night.
A night's sleep is longer, while this rest is brief and often happens in daytime. Some people feel more awake afterward. Others prefer to keep moving.

examples.en: A 20-minute midday power nap restores mental sharpness without causing post-nap grogginess.
examples.zh: 中午花二十分鐘進行短暫而高質量的「充電午睡」（Power Nap），能光速重啟大腦專注且醒來不昏沉。

examples.en: Avoid taking an extended two-hour nap late in the afternoon if you struggle falling asleep at night.
examples.zh: 若你平時夜間容易失眠翻來覆去，切記避免在傍晚下班前進行長達兩小時的深度長時午休。

examples.en: Many progressive tech campuses feature dedicated nap pods where coders recharge during busy afternoons.
examples.zh: 許多矽谷前衛科技大廠在研發辦公室旁特設未來感睡眠艙，供工程師在午後短暫打盹充電重振精力。

explains.en: A thick piece of material placed on the floor is called this. It can make a room warmer and softer. Use a non-slip pad to keep it from moving.
It may cover part of the floor rather than the whole room. Patterns and colors can decorate a space. Clean it regularly.
A carpet often covers most of a room, while this item may be smaller and movable. Both can feel soft underfoot. Keep edges flat to avoid trips.

examples.en: The small rug beside the bed felt warm.
examples.zh: 床邊的小地毯摸起來很暖。

examples.en: She rolled up the rug before painting the floor.
examples.zh: 粉刷地板前，她把地毯捲了起來。

examples.en: A colorful rug covered the center of the room.
examples.zh: 一張色彩繽紛的地毯鋪在房間中央。

explains.en: To touch something lightly with a finger or tool is to do this. A person may knock gently on a window. The sound can get someone's attention.
The word can also name a faucet that controls water. Turn it to fill a cup. Close it after use to save water.
A hard hit is stronger, while this action is usually light. The same word names a water control. Context gives the meaning.

examples.en: Tap the red icon on the screen to record a video.
examples.zh: 輕觸螢幕上的紅色圖示以錄製影片。

examples.en: Don't forget to turn off the bathroom water tap tightly.
examples.zh: 別忘了將浴室的水龍頭確實關緊。

examples.en: He tapped gently on the wooden office door before entering.
examples.zh: 他在進入辦公室前在木門上輕輕敲了幾下。

explains.en: A container holds things that people want to store, sort, or throw away. It may have a lid and can be made of plastic or metal. Labels help people use it correctly.
At the art table, children put paper scraps into a blue container. They placed clean sheets in a different tray. This kept the supplies neat.
A basket may be open and made from woven strips. A lidded container can keep items covered. The shape and purpose vary from place to place.

examples.en: Put the empty bottles in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 把空瓶放進回收桶。

examples.en: She stored the toys in a large plastic bin.
examples.zh: 她把玩具收在一個大型塑膠箱裡。

examples.en: There is a waste bin beside the desk.
examples.zh: 書桌旁有一個垃圾桶。

explains.en: This noun means a soft, silvery metal used to coat steel or make containers. It can also mean a small metal container for food. In British English, it may name a baking pan.
A food can is made from steel with a thin layer of this silvery metal to help protect it. The coating is useful because it resists rust. The noun names the metal.
A baker pours cake batter into a round baking pan. In some places, people use this word for the pan. The meaning depends on the country and subject.

examples.en: The old box was made of tin.
examples.zh: 那個舊盒子是用錫做的。

examples.en: She kept the biscuits in a blue tin.
examples.zh: 她把餅乾放在一個藍色鐵盒裡。

examples.en: The baker greased the cake tin.
examples.zh: 烘焙師在蛋糕烤模上抹了油。

explains.en: This noun means artificial hair worn on the head. People may wear it for warmth, fashion, costumes, or medical reasons. It can be made from real or synthetic hair.
An actor changes appearance by wearing long red artificial hair for a play. The piece covers the actor’s own hair. It is worn on the head.
A person may use artificial hair after losing hair or to try a new style. Different shapes and colors are available. The noun names this head covering.

examples.en: Heat-resistant synthetic wigs are styled with hairspray to hold spiky anime shapes.
examples.zh: 採用耐熱高溫絲合成假髮搭配強力定型噴霧，能完美雕塑出動漫主角標誌性的刺蝟頭。

examples.en: She brushed the long pink wig gently and secured it on a mannequin head.
examples.zh: 她用寬齒木梳輕柔地梳順粉色長假髮，隨後妥善固定在假人頭模上進行造型微調。

examples.en: Wearing a breathable wig cap prevents your natural hair from slipping out underneath.
examples.zh: 戴上一頂輕薄透氣的專用髮網，能有效防止真髮在長時間戴假髮時不慎鬆脫穿幫。

explains.en: This noun names a flat body part that helps a fish swim and steer. A tail part pushes it forward. Other parts keep it balanced.
Swimmers wear flat blades on their feet to push water backward. The equipment helps them move forward. Long versions are used for diving.
Some machines have flat parts that guide air or release heat. An airplane tail may have one that helps control direction. These parts have a shape similar to the ones on a fish.

examples.en: Long carbon-fiber freediving fins deliver powerful thrust with minimal leg fatigue.
examples.zh: 換上一雙超長碳纖維自由潛水長蛙鞋，只需輕輕踢動雙腿即可在水下產生強勁的無聲推進力。

examples.en: Adjust the silicone heel straps of your open-heel fins snugly before stepping into the ocean surf.
examples.zh: 在邁步走進海浪碎浪區前，務必將套鞋式蛙鞋的矽膠後跟調整帶微調至服貼腳踝的緊度。

examples.en: The marine biologist identified the predatory shark species from the distinctive shape of its dorsal fin.
examples.zh: 海洋生物學家僅憑海面上露出的三角形背鰭輪廓與特殊弧度，便精準辨識出該鯊魚的具體品種。
